title: Maxar restores Ukraine's access to high-resolution satellite imagery
snippet: Kyiv Independent — Maxar restored Ukraine's access to GEGD service in March 2026 after intermittent restrictions. Maxar has been one of Ukraine's most critical suppliers of very high resolution imagery (30-50 cm optical), exposing troop movements, war crimes, and supporting defense operations.
tag_reason: First run; no prior sources exist.
